title: Account Specialist, Spasticity & Movement Disorder - South Denver, CO
description:
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas – immunology, oncology, neuroscience, and eye care – and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  X ,  Facebook ,  Instagram ,  YouTube ,  LinkedIn  and  Tik Tok .
This role is field-based and candidates should live within a reasonable distance from the primary city. Talent will be hired at a level commensurate with experience.
The Account Specialist role promotes a product to community practices and health systems. Customer accounts may include community/private practices, community-based hospitals, academic medical centers, and government accounts (military treatment facilities and/or Veteran’s Affairs Medical Centers). The Account Specialist develops and maintains relationships with various accounts/departments such as neurology, pain medicine, physical medicine and rehabilitation, primary care, and pharmacy.
Responsibilities
Promote a product to meet/exceed sales goals in community/private practices as well as hospitals/health systems.
Identify/uncover customer needs (training, clinical, operational, reimbursement) and address with appropriate AbbVie resources
Provide education and clinical/injection training for residents, fellows, and other key hospital personnel.
Expert delivery of anatomical/procedural information and training, including the appropriate use of anatomical terminology to train injection paradigms/postures while highlighting various anatomical and injection insights and considerations.
Effectively utilize AbbVie's sales and data resources to enhance productivity and growth of AbbVie products while implementing U.S. Marketing Plan.
Collaborate with other Account Specialist to promote the product for approved indications and execute individual, department, or group resident/fellow trainings within hospital/health system accounts.
Bachelor’s degree in health, sciences, pharmacy or business-related field preferred or relevant and equivalent industry experience required.
Relevant and equivalent industry experience required in lieu of a bachelor’s degree is at least five (5) years of technical experience with three (3) or more years of experience within sales preferred and a high school diploma/GED required
Experience with Buy & Bill and/or Specialty Pharmacy products is preferred, in both health systems and private practice
Ability to lift/pull 25–100 lb. training models and meet necessary hospital credentialing/vaccination requirements
Valid driver’s license: Ability to pass a pre-employment drug screening test and meet safe driving requirements
Ability to travel adequately to cover territory, as well as overnight attendance at scheduled training events and sales meetings
Driving a personal auto or company car or truck, or a powered piece of material handling equipment
Documented history of strong sales performance, preferably in a clinical/technical/consultative sales role with multiple decision makers is preferred. Ability to manage a complex sell, learn procedural, technical, clinical, and anatomical information quickly and communicate/present/train to a variety of audiences
An essential requirement of your position is to satisfy all applicable health care industry representative (HCIR) credentialing requirements to gain and maintain entry into facilities and organizations that are in your assigned territory. You must also be in good standing and/or eligible to obtain these credentials.
These HCIR credentialing requirements may include, but are not limited to, background checks, drug screens, proof of immunization/vaccination for various diseases, fingerprinting and specific licenses required by individual state or cities. Please remember that you are solely responsible for ensuring that you satisfy all HCIR credentialing requirements and for any associated liability for failing to do so. AbbVie has resources available to you to help answer questions you may have.
Key Stakeholders
External: Specialty Physicians in Therapeutic brand area, pharmacists, nurses, others depending on brand plan.
Internal: In-field team members, Sales Management (i.e. DSM), Marketing Management, Training, Customer Excellence, & Brand Plan stakeholders.

The Associate Director serves as the day-to-day owner of essential marketing plans for JUVÉDERM, partnering cross-functionally and providing clear direction to both internal teams and external agencies to drive brand growth. This individual excels at cross-functional alignment, manages significant marketing budgets, and ensures all programs deliver on brand awareness, consideration, and conversion objectives.

• Assist with the annual brand planning process for JUVÉDERM consumer marketing, translating business objectives into effective marketing strategies and initiatives
• Oversee development and execution of integrated marketing campaigns across TV, digital, social, print, influencer, PR, partnerships, web, CRM, and earned media that drive consumer acquisition.
• Direct collaboration with creative and media agencies, ensuring clear priorities, high-quality deliverables, alignment with brand voice, messaging, funnel-based objectives, and website high value actions and adherence to timelines and budgets
• Manage media mix with media teams and oversee media planning and optimization, leveraging analytics to maximize ROI and inform optimizations.
• Provide strategic content development guidance to the brand team, championing innovation and best-in-class content and campaign strategy across paid and organic channels
• Own the measurement and reporting structure for all campaigns, ensuring robust KPIs and data-driven insights to optimize future efforts
• Act as the primary liaison with Regulatory, Legal, Medical, and Compliance to ensure all initiatives meet internal and external standards
• Manage cross-functional teams to execute flawless, consistent, and impactful brand experiences across all channels
• Manage the brand website strategy and oversee continuous user experience optimization in partnership with digital teams
• Manage consumer marketing budget and stewardship of POs
Drives management of brand line extensions and collaborates cross-functionally to develop strategy, positioning, and go-to-market (GTM) plans.
• Present key initiatives, performance results, and insights to executive leadership and other stakeholders
• Manage, coach, and develop direct reports; foster a high-performance team culture
Required   Qualifications:
• Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or related field required; MBA or related Master’s degree preferred
• 8+ years of consumer marketing/brand management experience
• Experience in aesthetics, beauty, fashion, wellness, or CPG marketing preferred
• Demonstrated success in leading large-scale, omnichannel consumer marketing campaigns
• Strong experience managing creative and media agencies

Ability to set vision, drive alignment, and foster collaboration
Proven portfolio or track record of developing successful integrated content campaigns across multiple digital channels.
Demonstrated expertise in content creation for digital (organic and paid), including strong visual and storytelling abilities.
In-depth knowledge of performance metrics and optimization techniques for both organic and paid content, leveraging data to inform content strategy.
Solid business acumen and ability to translate business and brand strategy into marketing programs
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, with proven ability to influence and inspire cross-functional teams
Strong business acumen and analytical mindset
High level of organizational and project management skills

title: Associate Director, Oncology Market Access Marketing
description:
About AbbVie
AbbVie's mission is to discover and deliver innovative medicines and solutions that solve serious health issues today and address the medical challenges of tomorrow. We strive to have a remarkable impact on people's lives across several key therapeutic areas including immunology, oncology and neuroscience - and products and services in our Allergan Aesthetics portfolio. For more information about AbbVie, please visit us at  www.abbvie.com . Follow @abbvie on  LinkedIn,   Facebook ,  Instagram ,  X  and  YouTube.
The Associate Director, Oncology Market Access Marketing plays a key role in preparing for the anticipated first-line DLBCL launch while supporting the brand across current and future indications. The role gathers and synthesizes payer, provider, reimbursement, channel, and field insights to support U.S. Market Access strategy development and execute the tactical plan. It builds the evidence, resources, partnerships, and operational readiness needed to protect access and support EPKINLY adoption. Success requires close collaboration within the AbbVie–Genmab alliance to align execution, share insights, and advance joint priorities.
Primary Responsibilities
Launch Readiness and Preparedness
•  Support Market Access readiness and preparedness for the anticipated EPKINLY first-line DLBCL launch by gathering and synthesizing payer, provider, reimbursement, channel, and field insights; coordinating readiness activities; tracking milestones and risks; and executing launch tactics in partnership with cross-functional and Genmab colleagues.
•  Gather insights from field teams, analytics, research, customers, and alliance partners to inform strategy development, brand planning, launch readiness, and financial planning.
•  Develop analyses, dashboards, and scenario assessments that help evaluate access risks, opportunities, trade-offs, and tactical performance.
Tactical Planning and Execution
•  Translate the Market Access strategy into actionable tactics, timelines, milestones, and performance measures across current and future indications.
•  Lead development, approval, launch, training, pull-through, and optimization of customer and field resources addressing access, reimbursement, value, and operational barriers.
•  Manage agency and vendor partners, budget, scopes of work, and cross-functional dependencies to deliver high-quality work on time.
Alliance and Cross-Functional Collaboration
•  Partner closely with Genmab counterparts to align insights, tactical plans, deliverables, and execution across the alliance.
•  Coordinate cross-functional work with Brand, Payer and Corporate Accounts, Analytics, HEOR, Strategic Pricing, Trade, Patient Services, Medical, Legal, Regulatory, OEC, and field teams.
•  Support recurring access forums by preparing insights, tracking actions, surfacing risks, and helping resolve executional barriers or escalate areas of misalignment.
Access and Adoption
•  Execute initiatives that protect broad access and enable EPKINLY adoption across payer channels and sites of care, particularly community oncology.
•  Track access, account activation, operationalization, and launch-readiness metrics; provide clear updates and recommended actions to Market Access leadership.
•  Plan and execute market research, advisory boards, and other insight-generation activities that inform future strategy and tactical optimization.
Required Qualifications
•  Bachelor’s degree required.
•  5–7 years of pharmaceutical or biotech experience in marketing, market access, payer marketing, reimbursement, account management, analytics, or a related commercial function.
•  Demonstrated ability to synthesize clinical, access, reimbursement, policy, and financial information into insights and executable tactics.
•  Knowledge of medical-benefit access, Medicare fee-for-service and commercial payer dynamics, utilization management, reimbursement, buy-and-bill economics, and provider or site-of-care considerations.
•  Experience supporting and coordinating cross-functional initiatives in a matrixed environment and influencing without direct authority.
•  Strong analytical problem solving, project management, communication, and presentation skills.
•  Ability to manage multiple high-priority workstreams, ambiguity, shifting timelines, agency partners, and budgets while maintaining strong execution discipline.
Preferred Qualifications
•  Oncology, hematology, or HCP-administered product experience strongly preferred.
•  At least 3 years of U.S. Market Access experience preferred.
•  Experience supporting launch or indication-expansion readiness for a medical-benefit product.
•  Experience with community oncology, GPOs, clinical pathways, payer and provider value communication, 340B, OPPS, ASP/WAC dynamics, or provider economics.
•  Alliance or co-commercialization experience strongly preferred, including experience coordinating shared priorities and deliverables across organizations.
•  Experience developing promotional and non-promotional resources for health care decision-makers and operational stakeholders.
•  Master’s degree in business, public health, health policy, health economics, or a related field.

Experience interfacing with government regulatory agencies.

AbbVie Analytical Research & Development (Analytical R&D) is a global analytical scientific organization responsible for all CMC analytical activities related to the development of AbbVie's pharmaceutical products.  Our scope includes AbbVie's diverse pipeline of innovative small molecule medicines and spans from the selection of Discovery candidate molecules to Late Stage Clinical.  We are building a world-class team of scientists and leaders who will drive the advancement of industry-leading analytical capabilities and make meaningful contributions to advance AbbVie's pipeline of innovative medicines.  Careers in AbbVie Analytical R&D provide unique opportunities to work with global and cross-functional teams to drive exceptional science and innovative product development strategies.  We are looking for diverse candidates with strong scientific experience to join the AbbVie Analytical R&D team and can offer exciting and rewarding career opportunities for these candidates.
Position Description:
This Senior Scientist – Solid State Characterization position will be in a technical specialty group - Physical Analytical Chemistry (PAC) withing Analytical R&D.  The PAC group is a global team of experienced and innovative scientists which utilize a diverse set of physical analytical tools to advance CMC development programs by providing insights and driving the understanding of materials, processes, and products.  Additionally, the group contributes to development and justification of control strategies and authors relevant sections of regulatory submissions across all development phases.
We are looking for a subject matter expert in X-ray and electron diffraction for crystallographic and solid-form characterization of drug substances (DS) and drug products (DP), from early form discovery through regulatory filing. The role focuses on single crystal X-ray diffraction (SCXRD), Powder X-ray diffraction (PXRD), electron diffraction (3D ED/MicroED), Rietveld refinement, quantitative phase analysis (QPA), and phase-appropriate polymorph quantitation methods both in drug substance and drug products. title: Engineering Manager, External Search & AI Optimization
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.
The Community You Will Join:
The Growth Platform (Marketing Technology) team’s vision is to drive long term sustainable growth for the Airbnb community. Our mission is to build best-in-class agentic systems, and capabilities to support the growth of all Airbnb products, current and future.
The External Search & AI Optimization team's mission is to make Airbnb the most visible and trusted destination wherever people search for travel, from traditional search engines to AI answer engines and assistants. We build landing pages, structured content, and platform that help travelers discover stays, experiences, and services across hundreds of thousands of destinations and a broad range of languages and locales. As a product, infrastructure, and growth team within Marketing Technology, we own our stack end to end: CDN, frontend, backend, data pipelines, and AI agents. We partner closely with Product, Design, Marketing, and Data Science, as well as engineering teams across the company, to grow Airbnb's visibility, organic traffic, and bookings.
The Difference You Will Make:
As the Engineering Manager for External Search & AI Optimization, you will lead a team of engineers, from early-career to staff, working across frontend, backend, and data. You will own the engineering strategy and roadmap as travel discovery expands from search results to AI-generated answers, balancing continued growth in traditional search with new investment in making Airbnb easy for AI products to read, cite, and recommend. In your first year, success means measurable growth in Airbnb's visibility, traffic, and bookings from search and AI, a single roadmap shared across functions, and a healthy team whose engineers are growing.
A Typical Day:
Lead, coach, and grow a team of full stack and data engineers, and create an environment where they own initiatives end to end.
Set technical strategy and roadmap with Product, Design, Marketing, and Data Science, and keep many concurrent cross-functional projects prioritized and moving.
Guide the team in building fast, reliable landing pages, content systems, and data pipelines that serve travelers, search crawlers, and AI agents across many languages and locales.
Drive responsible use of LLMs to generate, translate, and improve content at scale, with strong evaluation and quality practices.
Build the measurement and experimentation needed to show how search and AI referrals drive bookings, and communicate progress and impact to senior leadership.

title: Sr. Product Manager – Technical, Amazon Leo

You will work at the intersection of vehicle engineering, software engineering, modeling and simulation, and the PMT teams building our first-generation network, constellation and customer devices — synthesizing insights across all of them to define what comes next.

- Define the product vision and requirements for future-generation satellite connectivity systems, grounded in deep understanding of customer problems across consumer, enterprise, and public sector segments.
- Drive system-level trade studies in partnership with modeling and simulation teams — translating simulation outputs into product requirements and investment recommendations.
- Partner deeply with vehicle engineering and software engineering to understand technical constraints and opportunities that inform future system architectures.

Your morning might begin with a review of simulation results from the modeling team — a new trade study has landed overnight comparing architectural approaches for a capability that could unlock performance improvements for enterprise customers. Mid-morning, you’re in a working session with vehicle engineering, walking through how a proposed design change to the satellite bus impacts the connectivity services you’re defining. After lunch, you sit down with a PMT colleague who owns our payload software. You capture three hypotheses to validate with simulation runs.

You’re drafting a narrative that frames a customer problem — one that doesn’t have an obvious solution yet — and propose an evaluation framework for the engineering team to assess multiple architectural paths. You end the day in a cross-functional sync, aligning vehicle, software, and simulation teams on priorities for the next sprint of trade studies.

description:

- Define and own the multi-year roadmap for technical certification programs across global AWS data center job families (DCO, DCEO, DCMAT)

- Use data to identify gaps, prioritize investments, and drive continuous improvement across the certification portfolio
- Stay current on industry best practices in technical credentialing, psychometrics, and workforce capability frameworks
A day in the life
Your morning kicks off with a coffee in one hand and a certification pass rate dashboard in the other — because somewhere in EMEA, a pilot just wrapped and the data is interesting. You spot an anomaly suggesting training and assessment have quietly drifted apart, fire off a note to the JTA lead, and feel that particular satisfaction of catching something before it becomes someone else's problem. Mid-morning, you're on a call with a third-party vendor, diplomatically but firmly explaining why their proposed shortcut is a no-go — assessment integrity isn't negotiable. After lunch, you're turning a gnarly dependency map into a crisp two-pager for a VP business review, making the case for more resourcing to accelerate certification coverage in APAC. Late afternoon brings a working session with your instructional design partners and a site lead dialing in from Singapore, collectively figuring out whether a new performance-based assessment can scale across 12 sites with wildly different equipment setups (spoiler: it can). Our program assesses competencies tied to specific data center tasks, using practical and simulated environments to maintain high, consistent standards. We automate assessment delivery to keep the process simple, while ensuring independence and rigor through qualified assessors. Behind the scenes, we provide the tooling and data solutions that help sites plan and manage their workforce's capabilities.
Certifications are either role-based — mandatory for all Builders as part of onboarding and development — or specialty-based, tied to specific hardware or tools and managed by demand. title: Battery Algorithm and Model Calibration Engineer
description:
Apple is where individual imaginations gather together, committing to the values that lead to great work. Every new product we build, service we create, or Apple Store experience we deliver is the result of us making each other's ideas stronger. That happens because every one of us shares a belief that we can make something wonderful and share it with the world, changing lives for the better. It's the diversity of our people and their thinking that inspires the innovation that runs through everything we do. When we bring everybody in, we can do the best work of our lives. Here, you'll do more than join something — you'll add something.
Are you interested in working at the forefront of Battery Systems? In this role, you will own the development of algorithm and model calibration methodologies supporting battery New Product Introduction (NPI) and advanced technology projects. You will utilize your expertise in both electrochemical characterization and electrical bench testing to calibrate battery algorithms and models for next-generation consumer electronic products. You will be part of a multi-functional team developing a new class of battery systems — spanning algorithms, architectures, and products — as we improve the utility and performance of batteries across the Apple product line.
We are looking for an individual with a deep understanding of battery behavior and characterization techniques from both design and application perspectives. In this position, you will combine electrochemical and electrical engineering expertise for the following responsibilities below.
Minimum qualifications: Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, or a related field, with relevant industry experience.
Experience with battery cycling equipment such as Maccor, Arbin, or Bio-Logic.
Preferred qualifications: MS or higher in a technical discipline with at least 3 years of relevant industry experience.
Strong background in electrochemistry with understanding of Li-battery performance characterization and analysis, including fast-charge protocol development, longevity/degradation mechanism identification and prediction, and impedance modeling.
Knowledge of battery characteristics and diagnostic techniques including OCV, hysteresis, thermodynamic and kinetic diagnosis, EIS, and P2D model development.
Experience with cell R&D techniques such as 3-electrode and symmetric cell methods.
Experience with Matlab or Python for large-scale data mining and processing.
Familiarity with AI tools to develop processes for efficiency improvement, such as automated test scripting, automated review, and data processing.
Experience with and understanding of battery algorithm design, battery gauging, and system power management.

title: Cellular RF Systems Architect - RF Configuration
description:
At Apple, our work is dedicated to creating products that connect and enrich people's lives. The Cellular RF Systems Engineering team sits at the very core of that mission, defining the wireless technologies that enable seamless experiences for hundreds of millions of users worldwide.
We are looking for a cellular RF engineer to translate complex 5G and 6G use cases into optimized RF configurations that bring our products to life. Configurations define how the transceiver and front-end are set up for each band, band combination, and use case, including signal routing, port mapping, gain and linearity modes and front-end control settings. If you enjoy structuring complex systems, building tools that make work scale, and connecting RF hardware and software teams, this role is for you.
In this role, you will be responsible for the optimal interaction between our RF transceivers and RF front-end modules. You will turn advanced cellular capabilities, such as carrier aggregation, MIMO, SRS antenna switching and Multi-SIM into concrete transceiver and front-end configurations. You will work closely with transmitter and receiver teams to define and refine these configurations, and partner with hardware, software and validation teams to bring them into our products. You will develop tooling and automation that keep configurations consistent across programs and contribute to the system design documentation that guides implementation.
Minimum qualifications: Minimum requirement of a bachelors degree
Solid understanding of 3GPP 5G NR and LTE physical layer and RF requirements, including band combinations, carrier aggregation, MIMO and SRS.
Working knowledge of RF front-end architectures and the system-level impact of components like PAs, LNAs, filters, and switches.
Proficiency in Python, MATLAB, or C/C++ for data analysis, system modeling, and algorithm development.
Ability to critically analyze complex trade-offs, such as routing flexibility versus insertion loss or throughput versus battery life.
Strong communication skills with a proven ability to work across diverse, cross-functional teams to solve highly complex, multi-disciplinary problems.
Preferred qualifications: MS or PhD in Electrical Engineering with a focus on advanced cellular communication topics.
5+ years of experience in RF systems engineering or 10+ years in communications circuit design.
Experience translating system requirements into hardware configurations, control settings or structured system descriptions.
Familiarity with RF configuration frameworks is a plus.
Enjoy structuring complex information with a strong focus on precision and consistency.
Experience applying AI/ML to solve system-level optimization problems.
History of successfully balancing cutting-edge hardware innovation with the practical constraints of high-volume manufacturing.

title: Custom Circuit RTL Design Engineer
description:
Do you love creating elegant solutions to highly complex challenges? Do you intrinsically see the importance in every detail? As part of our Silicon Technologies group, you’ll help design and manufacture our next-generation, high-performance, power-efficient processor, system-on-chip (SoC). You’ll ensure Apple products and services can seamlessly and efficiently handle the tasks that make them beloved by millions. Joining this group means you’ll be responsible for crafting and building the technology that fuels Apple’s devices. Together, you and your team will enable our customers to do all the things they love with their devices. Do you have a passion for crafting entirely new solutions?
As part of our Digital Circuits Group, youʼll take imaginative and revolutionary ideas and determine how to turn them into reality! You and your team will apply engineering fundamentals and start from scratch if needed, bringing forward-thinking ideas to the real world! Your efforts will be groundbreaking, often literally. Join us, and youʼll help design the tools that allow us to bring customers experiences they have never-before envisioned. You will be part of an exciting silicon design group that is responsible for designing pioneering ASICs. In this role as a Custom Circuit RTL Design Engineer, you will be working with the custom circuits team to implement behavioral and structural RTL models of advanced custom digital circuits, translate specifications in assertions models, and verify equivalence of the RTL models to circuits. You will be at the heart of a processor design effort, making a critical impact delivering products to market quickly.
In this highly visible role as a Custom Circuits RTL Design Engineer, you will be at the center of a SoC design effort collaborating with all teams, with a critical impact on getting bug-free functional products to market quickly. This requires you to work closely with the circuit design team to review design and architecture specifications and with various design teams across the SoC partitions to understand the use cases and corner conditions to develop test plans. Furthermore, you will be required to develop the methodology for test benches and coverage monitors for functional coverage and assertions. You will also work on improving the RTL methodology as applicable to simulation and emulation scenarios.
You will have the responsibilities as follows:
- Design and implement behavioral RTL models for various custom SRAM arrays.
- Work with logic/architecture team to determine specifications and assertions for custom SRAM arrays.
- Work closely with custom circuit team to review schematics and understand how the RTL must model it.
- Work closely with DV teams to verify functionality.
- Work with SOC teams to successfully integrate custom RTL design into chip.
- Implement RTL methodology and new flows with understanding of GenAI capabilities and limitations in hardware design to successfully integrate custom RTL design into chip.
- Use GenAI assisted tools for faster debug and turnaround time.
Minimum qualifications: BS and a minimum of 3 years of relevant industry experience
Preferred qualifications: In-depth knowledge of digital design, behavioral (including emulation-friendly) and structural RTL coding especially as it pertains to SRAM and register file design
Knowledge of Verilog, System Verilog and experience with industry standard simulators and waveform debugging tools
Knowledge of regression and revision control tools, and scripting language (python / perl)
Knowledge of industry standard design and verification tools, such as ESPCV and/or LEC
Knowledge of regression and revision control tools.
Basic knowledge of viewing and understanding custom circuit schematics
Knowledge of custom circuit and SRAM design and DFT (ATPG/MBIST) is desirable.

title: Principal Security Architect, Data Center Security
description:
The Apple Services Engineering Security team is looking for a principal-level security architect to own end-to-end trust for Apple’s next generation of data center infrastructure, the assurance that every physical and logical component, from silicon to the running workload, operates in a known, verifiable, tamper-evident state, and that this trust can be cryptographically proven to any relying party before access or data is granted. This spans hardware root of trust, DPU/IPU offload security, software and workload integrity, and the attestation protocols that tie them together into a single verifiable chain. You will partner with silicon, firmware, SOC architecture, platform, and cloud infrastructure teams to design and integrate this stack, and you’ll represent Apple in the standards bodies that define how this trust travels across the industry.
You will architect and integrate security across four layers of the data center stack:
Hardware root of trust — secure boot chains anchored in silicon (fuses, eFuse-based identity, HSMs), platform firmware integrity (UEFI/BIOS measured boot), and the physical/supply-chain controls that establish an immutable, device-unique identity at power-on.
IPU/DPU and offload security — working with platform and networking teams to ensure SmartNICs/DPUs/IPUs, as the emerging trust boundary isolating tenant workloads from infrastructure management, have their own attestable root of trust, not just line-rate crypto and policy enforcement.
Software and workload integrity — measured, signed boot through hypervisor/OS/container runtime with an unbroken chain of custody from firmware to running workload; confidential computing primitives (enclaves, TEEs, confidential VMs); drift detection against measured baselines.
Attestation and verifiable trust — the mechanism that converts the above into a dynamic, per-session trust decision: signed quotes of measured state, verification against golden measurements, key sealing/unsealing tied to attestation results, revocation of compromised measurements, and remote attestation protocols that let this trust travel to the relying party that needs it, including the agent identity layer sitting on top of this stack.
You will drive design reviews and threat models with SOC architects and platform teams, define the architecture that lets each layer attest up to the next, and ensure quality and agility through rigorous testing, participating in on-call for the systems you ship.
Minimum qualifications: 10+ years of security/software engineering experience, including systems-level and infrastructure security
Deep, hands-on experience with hardware root-of-trust architectures (TPM, DICE, or equivalent) and measured/attested boot chains
Proven track record designing or implementing remote attestation protocols, key sealing/provisioning tied to attestation state, and measurement revocation
Proficiency in at least one of C, C++, Go, Rust, or Python, with solid Linux systems fundamentals
Experience designing gRPC/REST backend services for identity, key management, or attestation at scale
Preferred qualifications: Direct experience with DPU/IPU/SmartNIC security architectures — tenant isolation from infrastructure management, line-rate crypto offload, and attestable DPU firmware/identity
Contribution to industry standards for root of trust or attestation (TCG, OCP, Caliptra, DMTF/SPDM, Redfish)

title: NPI Technician
description:
ABOUT BASE

Base is America’s next-generation power company. We’re rebuilding the foundation of modern civilization–electricity–by deploying a vast network of distributed batteries that is transforming today’s fragile, centralized grid into a resilient and abundant system. We are engineers, operators, and creatives solving some of the most complex, interdisciplinary challenges of our time.




ABOUT THE ROLE

As a New Product Introduction (NPI) Technician at Base, you’ll play a hands-on role in bringing new battery products and manufacturing processes from early prototypes to full production. You’ll support prototype builds, validate manufacturing processes, and ensure each trial meets product specifications. Along the way, you’ll document observations, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and help refine processes that will eventually scale across our production lines. This role offers a unique opportunity to work at the intersection of engineering and manufacturing while helping turn new ideas into real, scalable products.

 

What You’ll Do

 - Support prototype builds and trial runs for new products and manufacturing processes

 - Assist in validating manufacturing processes to ensure product specifications are consistently achieved

 - Test and validate systems and components to support quality assurance procedures

 - Document observations during build trials and capture the state of assembly and process performance

 - Read and follow manufacturing instructions, mechanical drawings, and basic electrical documentation

 - Collaborate with engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams to evaluate and refine production processes

 - Provide feedback during change control and process improvement discussions

 

What You’ll Bring

 - Experience supporting prototype builds, pre-production runs, or early manufacturing trials

 - Basic understanding of electrical and mechanical systems

 - Ability to read and interpret manufacturing instructions and mechanical drawings, with basic electrical knowledge

 - High level of craftsmanship and attention to detail while maintaining speed and efficiency

 - Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities

 - Comfortable working across multiple projects and collaborating with cross-functional teams

 - Reliable, proactive, and quality-focused with strong initiative

 

About the Team

The New Product Introduction (NPI) team is responsible for bridging the gap between engineering design and scalable manufacturing at Base. Every prototype build, process validation, and trial run helps transform early concepts into reliable production systems. Your work will directly shape how our batteries are built at scale, refining the processes that power the factories of the future. As part of this team, you’ll collaborate closely with engineering, manufacturing, and quality teams while gaining exposure to cutting-edge battery technology and advanced production systems.



Please note: Base is a startup, which means priorities shift and evolve quickly. Your role may expand or change based on the needs of the business at any given time, so the responsibilities listed may not be exhaustive.




OUR VALUES

 - First Principles Thinking: Question assumptions. Principles > rules.

 - Operate at Base Pace: Focus on what matters, act quickly, and learn by doing.

 - Give & Get Feedback: Be direct, be humble, and maintain a growth mindset.

 - Everyone’s an Owner: Follow through on commitments and own results.

 - Strong Opinions, Loosely Held: Drive clarity and make calls with imperfect information.

 - Committed to the Mission: Rebuilding the grid is a big challenge. We work hard because we care deeply about the impact we’re creating. We work in-person. It’s not a 9-to-5. We are all-in.

 - Fun & Optimism Coexist with Grit: Collaboration and celebration coincide with the intensity of building real things.
   
   


DO THE BEST WORK OF YOUR LIFE AT BASE.

title: Hardware Systems Engineer
description:
About the Team
DoorDash Labs is an independent team within DoorDash. We are working on building autonomous delivery robots from the ground-up and other automation solutions as part of DoorDash's core delivery platform. If you have a passion for applying AI and robotics solutions in a service used by millions of people, then we want to talk to you!
About the Role
We're looking for a Hardware Systems Engineer to own system-level architecture across electrical, mechanical, firmware, sensor, and compute subsystems – decomposing platform requirements into verifiable specs for power distribution, motion control, embedded compute, sensor suites and communication buses (CAN, Ethernet, etc.). You'll drive requirements traceability, interface control documents (ICDs), trade studies, and verification and validation (V&V) plans that ensure subsystems built by separate EE, ME, firmware, and perception teams function as one safe, reliable delivery robot.
Responsibilities
Own system-level architecture across electrical, mechanical, firmware, sensor, and compute subsystems for autonomous delivery platforms.
Decompose platform requirements into verifiable specs for power distribution, motion control, embedded compute, and sensor suites.

Define fault-tolerant architectures (FMEA, fault trees, redundancy) governing system behavior during component failures.

Translate business and regulatory requirements into engineering specs in collaboration with Product, Safety, Legal, and Operations.

B.S., M.S., or Ph.D. in EE, ME, Computer Science, Systems Engineering, Robotics, or a related field
8+ years of experience building, testing, and validating mechatronics or sensor-equipped hardware in robotics, automotive, or aerospace.
Strong expertise in embedded systems architecture, vehicle mechanicals, electronics, and autonomous perception systems.
Demonstrated ability to perform cross-boundary debugging across hardware, firmware, and software layers.
Ability to evaluate complex trade-offs, identify failure modes, and translate ambiguous business and regulatory goals into precise, verifiable engineering specifications
Track record of leading complex, multi-disciplinary projects across EE, ME, firmware, and perception teams.

title: Senior Applications Engineer - CNC - Northeast
description:
About MISUMI Americas
MISUMI Americas, a division of MISUMI Group, is a leading provider of standard, configurable, and custom manufacturing solutions. By integrating a vast catalog of components with a world-class digital manufacturing platform, MISUMI Americas empowers engineers and procurement teams to accelerate innovation across the entire product lifecycle. With operations in the San Francisco Bay Area and Chicago, the company serves as a vital partner for the most innovative companies in the Americas.
Impact In This Role
Misumi Americas is seeking a Senior Applications Engineer - CNC to join our solution engineering team focused on strategic, high-complexity, production-level customer programs. This role sits at the intersection of engineering, manufacturing, customer advisory, and commercial execution, supporting customers as they scale from prototype into production.
The ideal candidate brings deep experience in CNC machining, casting, CAD, (SolidWorks), GD&T, and DFM skills, strong technical communication skills, and the ability to guide customers through DFM/DFA, production readiness, operational/program support, cost optimization, and mechanical assembly considerations. This role is mainly customer-facing and requires comfort operating in ambiguous, high-stakes environments.
What You’ll Be Doing
Customer & Program/Production Support
Serve as a trusted technical advisor/guide for strategic customers with complex CNC manufacturing needs.
Lead technical scoping discussions, translating customer requirements into manufacturable, scalable solutions.
Some level of support for customers through prototype → production transitions, anticipating manufacturing risks early.
Manufacturing & DFM Expertise
Perform detailed DFM/DFA reviews for CNC-machined components.
Evaluate part geometry, tolerances, GD&T, material selection, and finish requirements for manufacturability and cost.
Provide cost optimization recommendations based on process selection, feature simplification, and volume scaling.
Support efforts with manufacturing-informed input on feasibility, risk, and lead time.
Assembly & System-Level Understanding/Support
Evaluate and guide on mechanical assemblies, including:
Part-to-part fit, stack-ups, and tolerance interactions
Fastener selection, joint design, and access for assembly
Assembly sequencing and installation considerations
Help customers identify risks related to assembly, serviceability, and field installation.
Provide feedback that improves downstream assembly efficiency and reduces rework.
Technical Execution
Review and interpret engineering drawings with strong command of GD&T.
Perform CAD work, including:
Design updates for manufacturability
Parametric 3D Modeling & Visualization
Detailed Documentation & Drafting with GD&T
Optimizing CAD — CNC to Casting and 3DP to IM
Reverse engineering
Collaborate cross-functionally with Sales, Operations, Quality, and LoB teams.
Quality & Compliance Awareness
Apply working knowledge of ISO 9001 and AS9100D requirements in customer discussions and internal workflows.
Identify quality risks early and ensure proper requirements definition (“quality in, quality out”).
Desired Traits
6+ years of relevant experience in manufacturing roles such as CNC (candidates with deeper experience are strongly encouraged to apply).
Bachelor's degree in Manufacturing Engineering or related field, or equivalent demonstrated hands-on experience.
Strong expertise in CNC machining processes (milling, turning, multi-axis) and Casting, .
Must have DFM, cost optimization, and manufacturing trade-off fluency.
Hands-on experience in production-scale manufacturing programs.
Proven ability to interpret and apply engineering drawings and GD&T.
Solid understanding of mechanical assemblies and installation considerations.
Experience supporting customer-facing technical discussions.
Familiarity with ISO 9001 and AS9100D compliance environments.
Willingness and ability to travel 30–40%.
Proficiency with Google Workspace and/or Microsoft Office.
Strong verbal, written, and digital communication skills.
SolidWorks CAD proficiency.
Willingness to perform hands-on CAD work and reverse engineering as needed.
Willingness to support the Marketing team with technical publications, seminars, university lectures, and other related activities as needed.
Nice-to-Have Qualifications
Experience with Casting,  Molding (IM) and/or Additive Manufacturing (3DP).
Prior experience working with external suppliers or contract manufacturers.
Leverage AI tools (e.g., Claude and other AI assistants) to accelerate DFM analysis, documentation, customer-facing content creation, and day-to-day engineering workflows.
Experience integrating AI/LLM tools into engineering or customer-facing workflows.
Physical Demands
The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of this job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
Standard Office & Remote Work: Prolonged periods of sitting at a desk and working on a computer for remote customer consultations.
Onsite Environments: Must be able to walk and stand on manufacturing floors and trade show environments for extended periods. Must be able to safely navigate industrial areas around heavy machinery and wear required PPE (safety glasses, safety shoes, hearing protection).
Lifting & Handling: Ability to occasionally lift, move, and position mechanical parts, prototypes, or trade show materials weighing up to 30 lbs.
Perks and Benefits
Competitive medical, dental, and vision insurance
401K plan
Parental leave programs
Paid volunteer days
And much, much more!
Salary Range: $125,000 to $142,000 per year, based upon experience
Interested in learning more?  We look forward to hearing from you soon.
We’re actively seeking teammates who:
Bring diverse perspectives and experience to our culture and company.
Excel at being part of a strong, empathetic team.
Thrive in an environment emphasizing respect, honesty, collaboration, and growth.
Have an ‘always learning’ mindset that celebrates learning, not just wins.
Help us continue to build a world-class organization that values the contributions of all of our teammates
We encourage applications from members of underrepresented groups, including but not limited to women, members of the LGBTQ community, people of color, people with disabilities, and veterans.

The Senior Regional Air Freight Manager owns and leads all aspects of air freight performance, strategy, and business growth across assigned trade lanes and geographic territories (e.g., SouthCentral, Mountain and SouthWest/SoCal or designated regional trade lanes). This multi-dimensional role carries end-to-end financial accountability, down to Contribution Profit, while leading regional capacity procurement, bespoke door-to-door solution design, and go-to-market (GTM) commercial execution.
Serving as a key pillar of regional leadership, this role bridges global air freight strategy with local operational execution. Strategic Planning & Target Setting: Define and execute the region’s long-term air freight vision, program initiatives, focus lanes, and growth objectives in close alignment with Global Air strategy and regional leadership (GM).
P&L & Financial Accountability: Own full financial performance (including Tonnage/Volume, Net Revenue, and Contribution Profit, e.g. Net Revenue minus Direct Costs ) for assigned regional origin/destination combinations and trade lanes.
Performance Governance & Metrics: Co-define annual budgets with General Management and actively participate in weekly business reviews (WBRs) to report on key metrics, yield performance, target adherence, and shortfall mitigation plans.
Continuous Process Improvement: Drive operational efficiency and take-rate expansion by identifying structural bottlenecks, grounding decisions in rigorous data analysis, and driving initiatives to "build a better machine."

Account Retention & Expansion: Partner with Account Management to expand wallet share with existing clients through creative pricing, customized air charter/freight solutions, and proactive relationship management to prevent churn.
Market Intelligence & Communication: Continuously monitor air cargo market dynamics, rate fluctuations, capacity constraints, and competitor positioning. Regularly communicate actionable market insights to local and regional sales organizations.

Internal & External Representation: Represent the Global Air Team in regional executive meetings and represent the company externally at industry conferences, vendor summits, and customer events.

Experience
Industry Experience: 7+ years of experience at a freight forwarder or in a similar field
Solutioning & Pricing Expertise: 5+ years of direct experience designing complex, door-to-door air freight routing solutions and competitive pricing models for enterprise customers of varying sizes.
Commercial & Executive Engagement: Proven track record in business development, senior-level client relationship management, and winning strategic RFQs.
Network & Industry Rolodex: Established relationships with regional and global airline leadership, as well as an active client network within the region (highly preferred).

Financial & Analytical Acumen: Deep understanding of freight forwarding economics, P&L management, yield optimization, and data-driven decision-making.

High Energy & Collaboration: Proactive, highly energetic leader capable of operating seamlessly across time zones, from coordinating with overseas procurement teams at night to negotiating with local vendors and clients during the day.
Communication & Negotiation: Superior verbal, written, and presentation skills with a strong ability to influence internal stakeholders and external executive decision-makers.

title: Technical Program Manager
description:
Who we are:
Formic is on a mission to reshape American manufacturing by making automation accessible to every factory. As labor constraints rise, costs increase, and global competition intensifies, automation is no longer optional for manufacturers that want to stay competitive.
We deliver automation through a Robotics-as-a-Service model that combines industrial robotics, proprietary software, and full-service support into a single, integrated solution. By removing the traditional barriers of cost, complexity, and risk, we enable manufacturers to deploy automation quickly and realize measurable gains in throughput, safety, and operational efficiency without large upfront capital investment.
Backed by leading investors including Lux Capital, Initialized Capital, Blackhorn Ventures, and Mitsubishi HC Capital North America, Formic is scaling rapidly and building the foundation for a new era of high-performance, Made in America production.
About the team:
Formic's Business Systems team builds and manages the software, data infrastructure, and integrations that power our operations.
Our work touches nearly every part of the company. We build internal applications that help teams manage robot deployments and field service, connect operational data across platforms, and develop AI-powered tools that make information more accessible and work more efficient. We also help shape the systems behind our sales, marketing, finance, and other business processes.
Some solutions are custom-built applications. Others involve integrating existing platforms, automating workflows, or rethinking how information moves through the business. We work directly with the people using these systems and own what we deliver, including adoption, reliability, and ongoing improvement.
We're a small team with significant autonomy, tackling technical challenges across a robotics company where the software we build has a direct impact on real-world operations.
About the role:
We're looking for a technically strong, AI-forward builder who can turn complex business problems into working software.
You'll work directly with teams across Formic to identify opportunities and build solutions, whether that's developing an internal application, connecting systems that don't communicate, automating an operational process, or applying AI to make existing tools more useful.
You'll have the autonomy to determine what to build and how to build it, along with responsibility for getting it into production and making sure it works. We want someone who moves quickly, makes sound technical decisions, and cares as much about adoption and reliability as development.
This isn't a traditional product management role or one focused exclusively on AI. It's a hands-on opportunity for someone who loves building software and wants to see the impact of their work.
We care more about what you've built than your job title or career path. You might come from software engineering, applied AI, technical product development, business systems engineering, or a startup where you've worn several hats. What matters is that you know how to turn ideas into working software and can show us what you've shipped.
In this role you will:
Build and maintain internal applications, AI-powered tools, automations, and integrations that solve problems across Formic
Work directly with employees and business leaders to understand existing processes, uncover inefficiencies, and determine what should be built
Design technical solutions, including application architecture, APIs, databases, data pipelines, and integrations with existing platforms
Experiment with LLMs, AI agents, and emerging development tools, applying them where they offer a meaningful advantage
Connect information across business systems to improve data quality, visibility, and decision-making
Take projects from initial discovery through prototyping, development, deployment, and ongoing support
Build with security, reliability, maintainability, and scalability in mind, including appropriate testing and monitoring
Gather feedback, measure adoption and results, and continuously improve the products you deliver
Collaborate with engineering and other technical teams when projects require shared infrastructure or specialized expertise
Help determine the priorities, architecture, and technical direction of our Business Systems function
What makes you a great fit:
A strong track record of personally building and shipping software, internal products, automations, or other technical solutions that people rely on
Solid software development skills, including experience working with APIs, databases, and modern application development tools
Proficiency in at least one modern programming language, such as Python or TypeScript, and experience working with APIs, databases, and SQL
Hands-on experience integrating systems and working with data across multiple platforms
Practical experience using AI in software development or building AI-powered applications, with genuine curiosity about emerging capabilities
The ability to make thoughtful technical decisions without overengineering solutions
Strong product instincts. You can understand what users need, distinguish symptoms from underlying problems, and prioritize work based on impact
Comfort working independently, navigating ambiguity, and owning projects from beginning to end
An appreciation for what happens after launch, including testing, documentation, monitoring, maintenance, and user adoption
The ability to communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical colleagues
A bias toward action, intellectual curiosity, and genuine interest in how businesses operate
Bonus points if you have:
Experience building with LLM APIs, AI agents, retrieval-augmented generation, or agentic workflows
Experience building and deploying cloud-based applications
Familiarity with CRM, ERP, finance, or operational systems and the data that connects them
Experience with workflow orchestration, event-driven integrations, or data engineering
Experience building applications that handle sensitive business information
A background in robotics, manufacturing, industrial automation, logistics, or field service operations.
Experience working in a startup or small technical team where you've had substantial ownership.
Our Total Rewards:
At Formic, we believe people do their best work when they feel supported both professionally and personally. That’s why we offer a comprehensive benefits and perks package for full-time, U.S.-based team members, including:
Equity in Formic: Participate in our stock option program and share in the success of a fast-growing start-up backed by leading global investors
Competitive & Uncapped Commission Structure: Designed to reward performance and impact in commission-eligible roles
Comprehensive Healthcare Coverage: Medical, dental, and vision insurance through Blue Cross Blue Shield and Unum, with 99% of employee premiums covered and 75% coverage for dependents, with optional buy-up plans available
Additional Insurance Benefits: FSA and DCFSA, life insurance, short-term disability, and long-term disability through Unum, all 100% employer-paid
Employee Assistance Program (EAP): Fully funded by Formic, offering support when you need it most
Paid Parental Leave Program: Up to 12 weeks of paid parental leave
Company-sponsored 401(k): Invest in your future with our company-facilitated retirement savings plan
Home Office Stipend: A one-time allowance for fully remote and hybrid employees to support an at-home or on-the-road work setup
Monthly Cell Phone Reimbursement: Monthly stipend toward personal phone and internet expenses
Flexible Time Off: Take the time you need, when you need it, supported by our flexible PTO policy
Compensation Philosophy
Formic’s pay and equity packages are thoughtfully benchmarked against peer companies at a similar growth stage. Equity represents a meaningful part of our mutual investment: when Formic succeeds, so do you.
Final offers are customized based on experience, geographic location, market considerations, and a candidate’s preferred balance of cash and equity. Our goal is to attract and reward top talent who will have significant impact, and we are open to thoughtful discussions to align on the right structure.
Compensation Range: $135,000 — $175,000 USD What we look for:
We’re building this company from the ground up, and every person we hire has an outsized impact on our culture, performance, and trajectory. While each team member brings unique strengths and perspectives, we look for people who align with our Operating Principles and embody them in action. If this sounds like you, Formic may be the right place for you!
Fearless Optimism: You make bold bets and default optimistic. You believe in the mission, aren’t paralyzed by risk, and fear inaction more than failure. You see ambiguity as opportunity and bring energy to building what doesn’t yet exist.
Create the Magic: You absorb complexity so customers don’t have to. Whether your customer is external or internal, you focus on delivering experiences that are clear, fast, value-added, and outcome-driven. You don’t say “not my job.” You make things work.
Today, Not Tomorrow: You have a bias to action. You close the loop. You take extreme ownership. You understand that speed compounds, and you don’t confuse activity with results.
Seek Truth: You think from first principles. You value data over ego and strong opinions loosely held. You’re willing to challenge assumptions, including your own, in pursuit of the best answer.
Made of Rubber: You are resolute and adaptable. When things break or priorities shift, you rebound stronger. You treat setbacks as learning moments and move forward with grit.
One Formic: You operate without silos. You practice radical helpfulness, document clearly, and make clean handoffs. You assume positive intent and prioritize team success over individual credit.

title: Analyst, EFT Trade Compliance and Operations
description:
It started with a simple idea: what if surgery could be less invasive and recovery less painful? Nearly 30 years later, that question still fuels everything we do at Intuitive . As a global leader in robotic-assisted surgery and minimally invasive care , our technologies—like the da Vinci surgical system and Ion —have transformed how care is delivered for millions of patients worldwide.
We’re a team of engineers, clinicians, and innovators united by one purpose: to make surgery smarter, safer, and more human. Every day, our work helps care teams perform with greater precision and patients recover faster, improving outcomes around the world.
The problems we solve demand creativity, rigor, and collaboration. The work is challenging, but deeply meaningful—because every improvement we make has the potential to change a life.
If you’re ready to contribute to something bigger than yourself and help transform the future of healthcare , you’ll find your purpose here.
Primary Function of Position
The Analyst, EFT Trade Compliance and Operations is responsible for overseeing and
coordinating all international movements originating from the United States to destinations
worldwide, including but not limited to Mexico, Germany, Bulgaria, and Malaysia. The scope
includes equipment, service parts, repairs, upgrades, returns, loaners, demonstrations,
manufacturing-related tools, components, and materials. This role serves as the primary
coordinator for the end-to-end Shipment Authorization Form (SAF) process and as the
operational interface among engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, logistics,
customs brokers, suppliers, and trade compliance. The position owns shipment visibility,
status management, escalation handling, regulatory readiness, classification
governance, permit management, and export/import compliance from submission through
U.S. export and destination-country import. It ensures products are properly classified,
registered, documented, and compliance-ready before shipment approval.
Essential Job Duties
 Manage end-to-end international movements of capital equipment, repairs, returns,
demonstration units, components, service parts, manufacturing-related tools, and
materials from the United States to countries worldwide
 Serve as the primary point of contact for international outbound movements from the
United States and related returns, and lead cross-functional escalation calls for critical
shipments.
 Manage active Shipment Authorization Form (SAF) requests, monitor shipment
milestones and readiness, and serve as the primary owner of the SAF Helpline Zoom
Channel.
 Provide shipment status updates to engineers and project teams, track open issues,
and ensure timely resolution.
 Coordinate with customs brokers, freight forwarders, and logistics providers to
support timely U.S. export and destination-country import clearance and resolve holds,
delays, documentation issues, and classification discrepancies.
 Manage U.S. export and destination-country tariff classification activities.
 Partner with engineering, manufacturing, supply chain, procurement, suppliers, and
trade compliance to obtain and evaluate technical information required for classification
and country of origin determinations.
 Review engineering drawings, Bills of Materials, product specifications,
materials, component information, and product functionality to support HTS, Schedule
B, ECCN, and country of origin determinations.
 Verify completion of classification, country of origin documentation, FTA eligibility, metal
certificates, permit or license approvals, and customs documentation readiness.
 Evaluate destination-country import requirements, including permits, product
registrations, labeling or conformity requirements, special regulations, and customs
restrictions.
 Coordinate product data required for applicable customs, inventory control, and trade
compliance systems.
 Ensure products are compliance-ready before shipment authorization and support
inventory registration requirements and customs record maintenance.
 Ensure accurate tracking of exported, imported, transformed, returned, scrapped, and
transferred goods.
 Prepare, review, and validate commercial invoices, export filings, permits, licenses,
certificates, temporary import/export documents, and country-specific customs
declarations.
 Ensure compliance with U.S. export requirements, destination-country import
regulations, applicable trade laws, sanctions and restricted-party requirements, and
company policies.
 Maintain complete, audit-ready trade records and ensure proper export documentation,
recordkeeping, and regulatory compliance.
 Support engineering, manufacturing, service, and supply chain teams with global trade
compliance requirements.
 Support tariff and export classification, country of origin determinations, and trade
program utilization.
 Participate in internal audits and government compliance reviews, perform trade
compliance due diligence and transaction reviews, and support audits and
investigations.
 Identify compliance risks, implement corrective actions, and define requirements for
new shipment types and destination countries.
 Develop and maintain SOPs, procedures, work instructions, playbooks, knowledge
repositories, and classification databases.
 Identify process improvement and automation opportunities and support
implementation of global trade technology solutions.
 Maintain SAF tracking dashboards and monitor SLA performance; report shipment
aging, cycle times, backlog, and escalation metrics.
 Perform other duties, tasks, and special projects as assigned.
Required Skills and Experience
 Minimum 5 years of experience in:
• U.S.-Mexico cross-border operations

Oversee access to and ETL of data from various systems and file types, including the Snowflake enterprise data warehouse, in partnership with IT and data owners

Exceptional, effective, and tactful communication skills (both verbal and written)
Intellectual curiosity and a passion for continuous improvement and learning new technologies

Experience with Linux software development

Excellent communication and documentation skills
Passionate about delivering a quality product for the best possible user experience

Experience with GUI programming in Qt
Experience with performance profiling tools and optimization techniques for display/video subsystems

title: Scientist, R&D – Data Analytics & Operations​

description:
Job Description
Job Purpose
The R&D Scientist for Data Analytics & Operations uses R&D-owned data and technical knowledge to deliver accurate, actionable analysis that supports business decisions across business areas such as carbon accounting, nutrient profiling and compliance reporting, including Extended Producer Responsibility (EPR). This position keeps that data accurate, consistent, traceable and accessible for use across enterprise systems and digital solutions through stewardship, governance and documentation, and helps prepare it for use in a variety of digital tools and solutions. Working with regular guidance alongside Procurement, Corporate ESG, digital and other partners, the role represents North America R&D in enterprise sustainability and compliance initiatives, serving as a trusted link between R&D subject-matter expertise and cross-functional teams. It suits data professionals with food or CPG experience as well as food or packaging scientists with strong data skills.
Essential Functions & Responsibilities
​​Steward R&D data by investigating data-quality issues, reconciling discrepancies and keeping data accurate, consistent, and reliable across sources.
​Support data governance by applying established standards and maintaining definitions, mappings, taxonomy, metadata, validation checks and traceable documentation, flagging gaps to data owners
​Help prepare, structure and validate R&D data and content for ingestion into enterprise data platforms and downstream applications
​Query, combine and analyze R&D-owned product, ingredient, packaging and nutrition data to identify trends and deliver recurring reporting and analysis, for example carbon accounting, nutrient profiling and compliance reporting such as EPR
​Provide business requirements and validation criteria for automated, self-service and AI-enabled data solutions, and support testing for accuracy and relevance
​Use analytics to assess the impact of ingredient, packaging, specification or process changes across the portfolio by identifying affected products, technical dependencies and information gaps
​Participate in organizational sustainability and compliance initiatives, such as emissions-reduction and packaging programs, on behalf of North America R&D, contributing technical input and gathering information from R&D colleagues
​Collaborate with a wide range of cross-functional teams, support the use of relevant tools, data and guidance, and translate complex information for technical and non-technical partners ​
Manage multiple assignments across topic areas with regular guidance, moving between broad coverage and focused analysis as assignments require, prioritizing deliverables and escalating questions, risks and issues appropriately
Expected Experience & Required Skills
​​Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Science, Packaging, Chemical Engineering, Environmental Science, Agricultural Science, Nutrition, Data Science or a related field, or equivalent experience
​Minimum of two (2) years of relevant experience, or one (1) year with a Master’s degree, in data analysis, stewardship or reporting in a food, consumer packaged goods (CPG) or other regulated-product setting, or in food science, R&D or technical work with hands-on data analysis (post-graduation internship and co-op experience counts ).
​Proficiency in Excel and structured data analysis; SQL strongly preferred, or equivalent experience with tools such as Python or R.
​Working familiarity with R&D product, ingredient, packaging and nutrition data, and exposure to areas such as carbon accounting, nutrient profiling or regulatory reporting, including EPR.
​Learning agility, with a track record of quickly building expertise in new technical areas.
​Strong attention to detail and a commitment to data accuracy, validation and documentation.
​Effective communication, project management and problem-solving skills, including the ability to identify discrepancies, interpret findings and explain data findings to non-technical partners.
​Experience with Power BI or Power Platform, or familiarity with AI tools and with information and knowledge management concepts such as data governance, data stewardship, taxonomy and metadata.
​Ability to manage competing priorities and work collaboratively, with curiosity, sound judgment and a self-starter mindset.
​Willingness to travel up to 10%, with additional travel possible depending on location and business needs.
​ ​

We believe the office is a critical driver of innovation, connection, and development, but also realize providing flexibility to our employees is critical. To create a more agile and modern workplace, this position will be able to work virtually for up to two days each week and will be expected to work in-person at the assigned work location at least three days per workweek

A Microsoft Construction Quality Manager is responsible for governing the quality management system, auditing contractor quality performance, managing NCRs and quality metrics, identifying risks before they impact commissioning or operations, and ensuring data centers are delivered ready to perform—not just ready to complete.
Responsibilities
Core Responsibilities of a Microsoft Construction Quality Manager
1. Drive Construction Quality from Day One
Ensure facilities are built in accordance with design requirements, specifications, and Microsoft quality standards.
Promote a "Right First Time" culture to reduce rework, delays, and operational risks.
2. Audit Contractor Quality Programs
Verify General Contractors are executing their Quality Management System (QMS).
Conduct routine quality audits, inspections, and field observations.
Validate contractor compliance with Division 01 requirements, quality plans, inspection processes, and documentation requirements.
3. Manage NCRs and Quality Issues
Initiate and manage Non-Conformance Reports (NCRs).
Ensure corrective actions are developed, implemented, and verified.
Escalate unresolved quality issues to project leadership.
Trend recurring quality problems and drive systemic corrective actions.
4. Quality Management System Ownership
Establish and maintain project quality plans.
Review and align contractor quality plans before mobilization.
Standardize quality processes across projects and campuses.
5. Inspection & Test Planning Governance
Govern Inspection & Test Plans (ITPs).
Define hold points, quality gates, and documentation requirements.
Ensure Installer Verification Checklists (IVCs) and readiness requirements are met before commissioning milestones.
6. Digital Quality Platform Management
Administer quality tracking systems (Nexus/ACMS).
Monitor issue closure timelines and SLA performance.
Produce dashboards and quality metrics for leadership visibility.
7. Field Quality Assurance
Perform field inspections and observations.
Monitor workmanship trends and installation quality.
Verify contractors are following approved procedures and specifications.
Provide early identification of risks that could impact commissioning, IST, or turnover.
8. Readiness and Turnover Support
Support energization and commissioning readiness reviews.
Ensure documentation, inspections, punch lists, and quality issues are appropriately closed prior to turnover.
Partner with Commissioning Managers and Operations to improve startup outcomes.
9. Continuous Improvement
Analyze trends across campuses and metros.
Capture lessons learned.
Recommend process improvements that improve quality performance and reduce recurrence of defects.
10. Contractor Accountability
Hold GCs accountable for their QA/QC responsibilities.
Monitor closure performance and response times.
Reinforce that workmanship quality remains the responsibility of the contractor. Microsoft Quality provides oversight and assurance.
Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 5+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.
Preferred Qualifications:
Bachelor's Degree in Construction Project Management, Architecture, Engineering, or related field AND 8+ years related experience OR equivalent experience.
7+ years experience working on data center projects.
Proficient in data analytics, reporting, and construction management tools such as Power BI, Nexus, Bluebeam, and BIM with strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
Detail-oriented with strong knowledge of construction specifications, quality standards, and installation compliance requirements.
Experience with continuous improvement methodologies such as Lean, DMAIC, Six Sigma, and change management.
Experience applying structured problem-solving tools such as RCA, FMEA, 8D, and CAPA.
Knowledge of ISO 9001 Quality Management Systems, quality auditing, and Cost of Poor Quality (COPQ) principles.
Experience developing, implementing, and managing structured quality management systems.
Professional quality certifications preferred, including USACE CQM, OSHA 30, ASQ CQE, CQA, CMQ/OE, Six Sigma Green Belt/Black Belt, ISO 9001 Lead Auditor, or equivalent.
Experience in data center, mission-critical, industrial, semiconductor, pharmaceutical, power, or oil & gas construction environments preferred.
Other Requirements:
Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings.
